about: The governed registry of ownership. Every owner the pipeline publishes is one of the role labels below, never a person, so ownership survives a change of person. Each domain is a functional area that would still exist if a tool were swapped (a scanner, a CDN, a CI vendor), and each has exactly one owning role. Each KSI family has exactly one owning domain. The holder section records who holds the roles today.

holder.name: Sam Aydlette
holder.statement: One person, the operator, holds every role in this registry. The roles are kept separate so that each decision has a named owner, and so the same records would work unchanged with a different person, or a team, in each role.
